title: Minnesota DNR Paid Summer Internships
pay_text: $19.00 per hour, 20 to 40 hours per week
who_text: Students who will receive academic credit or meet a school requirement through the internship
description: The Minnesota DNR offers more than 200 summer internships around the state in a typical year, in areas like fisheries, forestry, parks and communications. Openings are posted each January on the Minnesota state careers website.
